scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run copy:static
scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist/sidepanel dist/images && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/sidepanel/index.html dist/sidepanel/index.html && perl -0pi -e 's#src="../../dist/sidepanel/index.js"#src="index.js"#' dist/sidepanel/index.html && cp images/* dist/images/
